segments.title: Pre-Show Setup & Mod Installation
segments.notes: Case and Kendelle configure Lethal Company mods (Needy Cats, Skin Walkers, reserved flashlight slot) while discussing Kendelle's streaming history, abandoned 'Lady Kendall' handle, and hypothetical child names.

segments.title: Lethal Company: Cat Hunt Marathon
segments.notes: Extended co-op run with rotating community players (Amir, Nathan, Fancy, Exterminator, X) focused on capturing modded cats across multiple moons; frequent mod toggling, glitch exploits, and escalating cat population.

segments.title: New Year's Eve Wrap-Up & Raid Out
segments.notes: Case announces January 1 'Best of Everything' awards stream at 2:00 PM PST, thanks top donor CV loves you, and raids out to reread.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors a five-hour New Year's Eve Lethal Company co-op marathon, manages mod loadouts, and announces next-day awards stream.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Co-hosts the Lethal Company session, drives the cat-collection objective, and reveals former streaming persona and personal history.

lore_notes.fact: Kendelle's former handle 'Lady Kendall' was banned on gaming platforms because the substring 'dike' triggered filters; she holds a film degree, worked in marketing, and appeared on FBE React.
Case and Kendelle joke about naming a hypothetical child 'Emperor D. Blackwell' (nickname Emmy) but confirm they do not plan to have children.
Case references the 'G4' community and admits to destroying a screen during a prior G4 event.
Kendelle commits to a one-night January stream, possibly Disney-themed.
Amir's birthday celebrated during gameplay; cat hunt dedicated to him.
Case announces New Year's Day 'Best of Everything' awards stream at 2:00 PM PST, citing top donor CV loves you.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell and Kendelle co-host a New Year's Eve Lethal Company marathon on the BIN flagship channel, troubleshooting a cat-collection mod while cycling through a rotating cast of community players. The broadcast culminates in a profitable but cat-dense final run before Case announces a January 1 'Best of Everything' awards stream at 2:00 PM.
